|game_text=Cancel an Effect with 'occupation' in title. (Immune to [[Sense]].) OR During your draw phase, if you have a Rebel scout alone at Back Door, draw destiny. Activate or retrieve 5 Force and place this Interrupt on bottom of Lost Pile if destiny < the number of your scouts on table.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Endor Celebration (V)]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB3-105-Endor_Celebration-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The Virtual Block 3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Endor Celebration (V)]].
* '''Original''' ([[Endor Celebration (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 3 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Cancel an Effect with “occupation” in title. [Immune to Sense] OR During your draw phase, if you have a Rebel scout alone at Back Door, draw destiny. If destiny < the number of your scouts on table, activate or retrieve 5 Force and place this Interrupt on bottom of Lost Pile.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Virtual Block 3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174313/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Endor Celebration (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) moved the condition “if destiny < the number of your scouts on table” to the end of the second option, set “occupation” in single quotation marks and writes the [Immune to Sense] icon out as “(Immune to Sense.)”: “Cancel an Effect with 'occupation' in title. (Immune to Sense.) OR During your draw phase, if you have a Rebel scout alone at Back Door, draw destiny. Activate or retrieve 5 Force and place this Interrupt on bottom of Lost Pile if destiny < the number of your scouts on table.”.<ref name="cl-1230_104-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock3Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064716/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142208/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock3Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref>
